answer: Quadratic identity staking turns a sybil haven into a losing bet. Identity number n costs n squared times 0.001 BNB, so the first costs almost nothing and the hundredth costs 10 BNB. Registration is simple. An agent stakes the fee, the registry posts the payment on a public knoll of proofs any peer can climb and inspect, and the stake unlocks after 30 honest days. Cheating burns it. Faking 100 agents costs 338 BNB, around $200,000, plus a month of waiting, while one honest agent pays a fraction of a cent. Like copper wiring, every extra strand you fake costs more than the last.
